metadata.description: Production-Grade Statistical Methodology Knowledge Base for Oncology SAPs

common_categorizations.pooling_rules: Asia-Pacific may be pooled with ROW if <15%

common_categorizations.use_case: Global studies with significant Asian enrollment

prior_therapy_lines.name: Number of Prior Lines of Systemic Therapy

common_categorizations.use_case: When all patients had prior therapy

prior_therapy_lines.derivation: Count of prior systemic anticancer regimens

tumor_burden.name: Baseline Tumor Burden
tumor_burden.derivation: Sum of longest diameters of all target lesions at baseline

missing_stratum.handling: Assign to most common category OR create 'Unknown' category
missing_stratum.sensitivity: Perform sensitivity analysis excluding subjects with missing stratification

stratified_vs_unstratified.primary: Use stratification factors from IXRS (as randomized)
stratified_vs_unstratified.sensitivity: Re-derive stratification factors from CRF data

CNSR.name: Censoring Flag
CNSR.derivation: Set based on censoring rules table

derivation.censored: Date of last adequate assessment or last known alive

common_origins.efs: Randomization date or date of surgery

AVALC.name: Analysis Value (Character) - Best Overall Response
AVALC.hierarchy: CR > PR > SD > PD > NE > UNK

RSRESP.name: Response Flag for ORR
RSRESP.derivation: Y if AVALC in ('CR', 'PR'), otherwise N

DTEFIRST.name: Date of First Confirmed Response
DTEFIRST.derivation: Earliest date where response = CR or PR and confirmed >= 4 weeks later

DTCONF.name: Date of Response Confirmation
DTCONF.derivation: Date of confirming scan >= 28 days after initial response

PCHG.name: Percent Change from Baseline in Sum of Diameters

NADIR.name: Nadir (Best % Change)
NADIR.derivation: Minimum of all PCHG values up to and including assessment

BASE.name: Baseline Value
BASE.definition: Last non-missing value on or before first dose date
rules: Use screening value if no baseline visit value
For tumor: Sum of target lesion diameters at baseline scan

ABLFL.name: Baseline Record Flag
ABLFL.derivation: Last record on or before TRTSDT

TRTSDT.name: Treatment Start Date
TRTSDT.derivation: Date of first dose of study drug

TRTEDT.name: Treatment End Date
TRTEDT.derivation: Date of last dose of study drug

SAFFL.name: Safety Population Flag
SAFFL.derivation: Y if received at least one dose of study drug

FASFL.name: Full Analysis Set Flag
FASFL.derivation: Y if ITTFL='Y' and has at least one post-baseline efficacy assessment

PPROTFL.name: Per-Protocol Population Flag
PPROTFL.derivation: Y if FASFL='Y' and no major protocol deviations

RESPFL.name: Response Evaluable Flag
RESPFL.derivation: Y if has measurable disease at baseline and >=1 post-baseline tumor assessment

LKADT.name: Last Known Alive Date
LKADT.derivation: Latest of: Last clinic visit, Last contact, Last survival follow-up

pfs.name: Progression-Free Survival
pfs.definition: Time from randomization to first documented disease progression (per RECIST v1.1) or death from any cause, whichever occurs first
pfs.formula: (min(Date of Progression, Date of Death) - Randomization Date + 1) / 30.4375

os.name: Overall Survival
os.definition: Time from randomization to death from any cause
os.censoring: Last known alive date for subjects still alive

follow_up.method: Site visit, telephone, or public records search

dor.name: Duration of Response
dor.definition: Time from first documented CR or PR to disease progression or death
dor.formula: (Date of Progression or Death - Date of First Response + 1) / 30.4375
dor.population: Subjects with confirmed CR or PR (Responder population)
dor.censoring: Last adequate tumor assessment for subjects without event
dor.confirmation_requirement: Response must be confirmed at least 4 weeks later

ttr.name: Time to Response
ttr.definition: Time from randomization to first documented objective response (CR or PR)
ttr.formula: (Date of First Confirmed Response - Randomization Date + 1) / 30.4375

ttp.name: Time to Progression
ttp.definition: Time from randomization to disease progression

ttf.name: Time to Treatment Failure
ttf.definition: Time from randomization to discontinuation of treatment for any reason

efs.name: Event-Free Survival
efs.definition: Time from randomization/surgery to disease event

dfs.name: Disease-Free Survival
dfs.definition: Time from surgery to recurrence or death

pfs_censoring.description: Complete censoring rules for PFS analysis

rules.situation: No baseline tumor assessment, no death
New anticancer therapy started before documented PD
rules.event_date: Last adequate assessment before new therapy

rules.situation: Progression documented after >= 2 consecutive missed assessments
rules.event_date: Last adequate assessment before missed visits

rules.situation: Long gap (>=12 weeks + window) between assessments before PD

rules.event_date: Last adequate assessment before missed visits

rules.situation: Ongoing without progression at data cutoff

pfs_censoring.adequate_assessment: Complete tumor assessment per RECIST v1.1 including all target and non-target lesions
sensitivity_approaches: Treat deaths after missed visits as events
Include all assessments regardless of gaps
Use clinical progression if radiologic unavailable

last_known_alive_hierarchy: Date of data cutoff (if no other date)

components.O_i: Observed events in treatment group at time i

model.stratified: h_k(t|X) = h₀ₖ(t) × exp(β×TRTA) for stratum k

breslow.name: Breslow approximation
breslow.bias: Slightly biased toward null with many ties

components.d_i: Number of events at time t_i
components.n_i: Number at risk just before time t_i

landmark_estimates.output: Ŝ(t) with 95% CI at each timepoint

fleming_harrington.name: Fleming-Harrington Weighted Log-Rank Test
fleming_harrington.use_case: When proportional hazards assumption may not hold

immunotherapy_application.rationale: Immune checkpoint inhibitors often show delayed effect

rmst.name: Restricted Mean Survival Time
rmst.definition: Area under survival curve up to restriction time τ

difference.interpretation: Additional mean survival time with treatment up to τ

methods: Minimum of maximum follow-up across arms

agresti_coull.name: Agresti-Coull
agresti_coull.formula: Add z²/2 successes and failures, then compute Wald

wald.name: Wald (Normal approximation)
wald.use: Only for large samples, p near 0.5

mar.name: Missing At Random (MAR)
mar.definition: Missingness depends only on observed data
mar.primary_analysis: Typically assume MAR for primary analysis

start_date_missing_day_month.condition: Year same as or after first dose year

investigator_assessment.description: Use investigator assessment instead of IRC

per_protocol_population.description: Exclude subjects with major protocol deviations
per_protocol_population.purpose: Assess in population adhering to protocol

excluding_early_progressors.purpose: Assess excluding potential misclassified baseline progressors

different_censoring.description: Treat deaths after missed visits as events

all_scans.purpose: Assess if local progression was confirmed

adjusted_analysis.description: Cox model adjusting for baseline covariates

rpsft.name: Rank Preserving Structural Failure Time
rpsft.estimation: G-estimation via grid search for ψ where Z-statistic = 0

ipcw.name: Inverse Probability of Censoring Weighting
ipcw.use: Adjust for informative censoring due to crossover
ipcw.model: Cox model for probability of censoring/switching
ipcw.weights: 1 / P(Not censored at time t | covariates)

two_stage.name: Two-Stage Estimation
stages: Apply to switchers to get counterfactual

excluding_crossover.note: Biased, not recommended as primary sensitivity

tipping_point.name: Tipping Point Analysis
procedure: Add delta to imputed values in treatment arm
Report delta value at which significance lost

pattern_mixture.name: Pattern Mixture Model
pattern_mixture.method: Different distributions for different missing patterns

fixed_sequence.name: Fixed Sequence (Hierarchical) Testing
procedure: If H1 rejected, test H2 at α level
Continue only if previous hypothesis rejected
fixed_sequence.advantage: Full α at each step, no adjustment needed

implementation.information_fraction: t = events observed / total planned events

graphical_approach.name: Graphical Multiple Comparison Procedure
procedure: Start with initial α allocation (sum = α)
Test hypothesis with largest allocated α
If rejected, redistribute α along edges
Update graph, repeat until no rejections

hochberg.name: Hochberg Step-Up
procedure: Reject all if largest p ≤ α

hazard_ratio.model: Unstratified Cox regression within each subgroup

interaction_test.model: Cox model with treatment × subgroup interaction

consistency_criteria.qualitative: HR on same side of 1 in all subgroups

teae_definition.name: Treatment-Emergent Adverse Event
teae_definition.definition: AE with onset on or after first dose through safety follow-up period

window.end: Date of last dose + 28 days (or 90 days for SAEs in some protocols)

teae_definition.baseline_ae: AE with onset before first dose
teae_definition.worsening: Pre-existing AE that worsens in severity after first dose

grades.2: Moderate; minimal, local or noninvasive intervention
grades.3: Severe or medically significant but not life-threatening

counting_rules.subject_level: Count subject once per PT at worst grade
counting_rules.soc_level: Subject counted once per SOC at worst grade of any PT
counting_rules.multiple_episodes: Same PT different episodes counted as one subject

rate.formula: (Number of subjects with event / Total patient-years) × 100
rate.name: Events per 100 patient-years

incidence_rate.note: Counts all events, not just subjects

shift_tables.denominator: Subjects with baseline and ≥1 post-baseline value

fact_g.name: FACT-G (Functional Assessment of Cancer Therapy - General)

time_to_deterioration.handling_death: Count as event (definitive TTD) or censor

missing_data.compliance: Report completion rates by visit and arm

later_phase.frequency: Every 8 weeks (56 days) or 12 weeks (84 days)
later_phase.trigger: After Week 24 or after confirmed response

safety_windows.on_treatment: First dose through last dose + 28 days

analysis_visit_derivation.method: Assign to target visit within window

os_interim_at_pfs_final.timing: At time of final PFS analysis

sample_size_re_estimation.unblinded: Requires careful planning to preserve Type I error

clinical_cutoff.definition: Last date for which data will be included in analysis

components.efficacy: All scans with results available by cutoff
components.safety: All AEs with onset on or before cutoff
components.survival: Survival status as of cutoff date

database_lock.timing: After data cutoff, query resolution, medical review
database_lock.freeze: No changes to data after lock

event_driven_analysis.trigger: When target number of events reached
event_driven_analysis.example: Final PFS analysis at 300 PFS events

follow_up_requirements.minimum: All subjects with minimum X months follow-up
